title: build save of an id with no draft, an id that is not kebab-case, and bad arguments are rejected before anything is shown or written
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and B3-18/B3-19 (a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK: a terminal, or the token of the content he read; the guard denies the agent)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). `build save` reads only `.jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml`: an id with no draft is `JITSO REJECTED: no draft "<id>"`; an id that is not kebab-case (a path, for example) is `JITSO REJECTED: build id must be kebab-case` and is never turned into a path; no id is `JITSO REJECTED: build save needs a draft id`; `--confirm` with no value is `JITSO REJECTED: --confirm needs a value`; any other word is an unknown argument. All exit 2 with nothing on stdout. The oracle has no `build save` (the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs the `+ ` lines, the token text or the written file FAILS on it.
